info.title: OSPFv3_LSA
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

adv_router.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_LSA](#/OSPFv3_LSA)
The Router ID of the advertising router. The Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

dest_router.description: The Router ID of the destination router. This is in the IPv4 address format.

interface_name.description: Name of the interface to which the LSA belongs. This is applicable in case of Link LSA.

ls_birth_time.description: The OSPFv3 LSA birth time, number of seconds elapsed since Epoch, which can be used to compute LSA age.

ls_id.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_LSA](#/OSPFv3_LSA)
The OSPFv3 Link State ID.

ls_seq_num.description: The sequence number of the LSA.

lsa_prefix.description: The IPv6 prefix to which this LSA belongs. This is applicable in case of Inter Area Prefix LSA, External LSA and NSSA External LSA.

lsa_type.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_LSA](#/OSPFv3_LSA)
The type of the OSPFv3 LSA.

num_network_links.description: Total number of network links. This is applicable in case of Network LSA.

num_router_links.description: Total number of router links. This is applicable in case of Router LSA.

ospf_area.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_LSA](#/OSPFv3_LSA)
Area to which the LSA belongs.

ospf_router.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPFv3_LSA](#/OSPFv3_LSA)
OSPFv3 Router to which the LSA belongs.

ref_ls_id.description: The OSPFv3 Link State ID to which this particular link is referring to. This is applicable in case of Intra Area Prefix LSA. This referrered LSA Id should refer to existing LSA Id of Router LSA or Network LSA.

ref_ls_type.description: The OSPFv3 Link State type to which this particular link is referring to. This is applicable in case of Intra Area Prefix LSA. The referred Link State type should be Router LSA or Network LSA.

router_lsa_bits.description: The Router LSA Bits denotes different flags set for this particular Router LSA. These flags could be: Bit V: the router is an endpoint of one or more fully adjacent virtual links. Bit E: the router is an AS boundary router. Bit B: the router is an area border router. Bit x :The bit is unused should be set to 0. Bit Nt: the router is an NSSA border router.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: OSPF_Router.instance_tag
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv2 Router instances.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
